question: For the drivers who took part in the race in 1983/7/16, what's their race completion rate?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rr.time_results IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(rr.resultId) AS race_completion_rate
FROM race_results AS rr
WHERE rr.date = '1983-07-16'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.positionText = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.resultId)
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN race_results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.date = '1983-07-16'
